target: phyllode leaf PO:0025335 + absent PATO:0000462 (the pitcher leaves, PO:0009025 vascular leaf, stay present)
fix: 'phyllodia/phyllodes absent' = absence of PO:0025335 phyllode leaf only; an absence must never be annotated on a superclass of the part named (leaf for phyllode)
reason: Sarracenia has pitcher leaves; the flora says only that flat phyllodia are lacking. The hairy adaxial surface is the pitcher's.

target: basal leaf sheaths without blades: scale leaf PO:0006003 (or leaf sheath PO:0020104 + basal FLOPO:0991002); no leaf lamina absence
fix: 'bladeless sheaths' / 'basal sheaths bladeless' describes the lowest leaves reduced to sheaths (cataphylls); it is never 'leaf lamina absent' for the taxon. Map to scale leaf PO:0006003 or a basal-qualified sheath
reason: Carex has basal bladeless sheaths and blade-bearing foliage leaves; the doc names exactly this case.

target: cauline leaf PO:0000013 + absent PATO:0000462; basal leaves (rosette leaf PO:0000014) present, rosulate
fix: '<cauline|stem|basal|upper|lower> leaves absent' = absence of the qualified member (PO:0000013 cauline leaf, PO:0000014 rosette leaf, or leaf + FLOPO:0991117/0991002/0991376/0991377); the bare part may not be annotated absent
reason: Qualifier 'cauline' dropped; scapose crucifer with basal rosette.

target: stem/scape leafless: cauline leaf PO:0000013 + absent PATO:0000462; basal leaves present
fix: 'leafless' inside a stem/scape clause ('stems leafless', 'scape leafless') = cauline leaves absent, not leaves absent for the plant; 'leafless' must take its bearer from the clause subject
reason: Crepis rigescens has basal leaves; 'leafless' refers to the flowering stem. The 'glabrous' statement is attached to leaf with uncertain bearer.

target: 'sheath margins glabrous' = leaf sheath margin PO:0025619 + glabrous PATO:0000453; the absence is leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 + trichome PO:0000282 (oral setae) absent, not stipule
fix: In grass/bamboo descriptions 'auricle(s)' maps to PO:0020106 leaf sheath auricle and 'sheath (margins/apex)' to leaf sheath PO:0020104 / PO:0025619, never to stipule; 'oral setae' = trichomes at the sheath mouth
reason: Both statements were mapped to stipule; sheath margins are not auricles, so with correct parts there is no conflict.

target: no annotation (flowers unrecorded, missing data)
fix: 'not known', 'not seen', 'unknown', 'not observed', 'not available', 'inconnu(es)', 'non vu(es)' = missing data, never PATO:0000462 absent
reason: The flora had no flowering material; the cymes were described from inflorescence/fruiting material.

target: marginal (intramarginal) vein absent: vascular bundle PO:0005020 at leaf margin PO:0020128 (leaf vascular system PO:0000036) + absent PATO:0000462
fix: In '<modifier> vein absent' the head noun 'vein' is the absent part; the absence may not climb to the lamina that bears it. Generally: annotate the absence on the head noun of the noun phrase, not on the bearer of the clause
reason: The lamina is clearly present (glabrous); only the marginal vein is lacking.

target: no annotation (flowers unrecorded)
fix: Same as 'not known': 'flowers not seen' is missing data, never absence
reason: 'many-flowered' (racemes) and 'flowers not seen' do not contradict in the plant; the second says nothing about absence.

target: culm sheath (sheath of culm leaf): auricles and oral setae absent; foliage leaf sheath: auricles falcate (PO:0020106 + PATO falciform)
fix: In bamboo descriptions statements under 'Culm sheaths' and under 'Leaf sheath/Leaves' belong to different bearers; the culm-sheath block must keep its own bearer (culm leaf / scale leaf PO:0006003 sheath), not merge into leaf sheath
reason: FoC bamboo descriptions describe culm sheaths and foliage leaf sheaths separately; their auricles can differ.

target: 'apex truncate' = sheath apex (culm/leaf sheath PO:0020104 apex) + truncated; the absence is leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent, not stipule
fix: An 'apex <shape>' clause takes the bearer of the sentence (sheath), not the last mentioned or absent part; and 'auricle' maps to PO:0020106, never to stipule
reason: Both statements were mapped to stipule; the truncate apex belongs to the sheath, so there is no real conflict.

target: involucre bracts absent vs. bracteoles (involucel) leaf-like; or bracts 'absent or 1, leaf-like'
fix: In umbels 'bracts' (involucre) and 'bracteoles' (involucel) are different members; because PO:0009055 bract has 'bracteole' as a synonym, keep the involucre/involucel context (FLOPO:0991379 outer, or a bracteole class) when an absence is stated; 'absent or N, <quality>' is an alternative, not a plain absence
reason: Sinocarum: bracts usually absent, bracteoles present and leaf-like. Lumping both under bract creates the conflict.

target: capitulum not calyculate: outer supplementary bracts (bract PO:0009055 + outer FLOPO:0991379) absent; phyllaries (involucral bract PO:0009045) present, margin scarious
fix: In Asteraceae 'involucre/capitula not bracteate', 'ecalyculate', 'without bracteoles' = no calyculus bracts outside the phyllaries, never absence of PO:0009045 involucral bract
reason: Sinosenecio has phyllaries with scarious margins; 'not bracteate' refers to the calyculus/peduncle.

target: no absence: leaves confined to apex of the shoot/at base of flowering stems (leaf + position), crowded, subrosulate
fix: 'leafless except at <region>' and 'leafy only at <region>' = position of the leaves (restricted to that region), never leaf absent
reason: The 'except' clause states where leaves are; the other statement describes them there.

target: cauline leaf PO:0000013, few (reduced number); no absence
fix: Hedged absences ('almost', 'nearly', 'subleafless', '± leafless', 'sometimes', 'often') are not PATO:0000462 absent; read as reduced number/frequency or drop
reason: 'almost leafless' and 'stem leaves few' say the same thing.

target: ray florets (neuter): style absent; disc florets: style present, bulbous at base (check: 'bulbeux à la base' may describe hairs, then present_misread to trichome PO:0000282)
fix: In Asteraceae, statements about ray (ligulate, neuter/female) and disc florets belong to different members; keep 'fleurs ligulées/du rayon' vs 'fleurs du disque' as bearer context. A detached 'bulbeux à la base' must take its bearer from its own clause (often 'poils')
reason: Bidens rays are sterile and lack a style; disc florets have one. The present text is a fragment, so the bearer is uncertain.

target: lateral/external bracts on the fig receptacle (bract PO:0009055 + lateral FLOPO:0991380 or outer FLOPO:0991379) absent; basal bracts present
fix: 'sans bractées externes/latérales', 'without lateral bracts' (Ficus) = absence of the qualified bract member only; basal bracts are a different member
reason: Ficus figs have basal bracts and may or may not have lateral bracts on the body.

target: lateral bracts of the fig (bract PO:0009055 + lateral FLOPO:0991380) absent; basal bracts 3, subverticillate
fix: Same as X03015: a positional qualifier (lateral, external, basal) restricts the absence to that member
reason: Qualifier 'lateral' dropped.

target: leaf lamina PO:0020039 not punctate (negation of PATO:0001512 punctate); no part absence
fix: '<surface feature> absent' (dots, glands, pellucid dots, papillae, hairs) = absence of the feature, or negation of its quality (punctate, glabrous), never absence of the organ described
reason: Myristicaceae leaves are described for dots beneath; the leaf itself is present.

target: leaf lamina PO:0020039 not punctate (negation of PATO:0001512)
fix: Same as X03017
reason: Dots absent ≠ lamina absent.

target: lower glume PO:0006002 + absent PATO:0000462; the upper glume is pilose
fix: 'lower/upper/first/second glume' map to PO:0006002 lower glume / upper glume; an absence of an ordinal member must not be annotated on PO:0009039 glume
reason: Digitaria often lacks the lower glume; the pilose glume is the upper one.

target: scape/peduncle without bracts (bract PO:0009055 absent on the scape); involucral bracts PO:0009045 present, acute
fix: 'ebracteate' in a scape/peduncle clause = no bracts on the axis; in Asteraceae it never means phyllaries absent
reason: Gerbera is scapose; the phyllaries are described as acute.

target: glumes (or cleistogamous axillary spikelets) awnless vs. lemma of chasmogamous spikelets with slender awn
fix: 'awnless' takes its bearer from the clause (glumes, lemma, palea, a spikelet type); annotate 'awn absent' with that bearer and spikelet context, never as a taxon-level awn absence
reason: M. microsperma has awned lemmas but awnless glumes, and cleistogamous spikelets with reduced or no awns.

target: lower (sterile) floret: palea absent; fertile upper floret: palea involute
fix: GrassBase 'Basal sterile florets ... without significant palea' belongs to the sterile floret; keep the floret context (lower FLOPO:0991377, sterile PATO:0000956) on the absence
reason: In Paspalum the lower floret lacks a palea while the fertile floret has one.

target: trichome PO:0000282 absent on the leaf, i.e. leaf glabrous PATO:0000453
fix: Character-state headings ('Hairs: absent', 'Indumentum: absent') name the absent part; the absence belongs to trichome, not to the organ of the record
reason: Structured data where the character is hairs; the leaf is present (V-shaped).

target: basal sheaths bladeless: scale leaf PO:0006003 or leaf sheath PO:0020104 + basal FLOPO:0991002; blades of foliage leaves green
fix: Same as X03001: 'bladeless' attached to sheaths = cataphyll-like basal sheaths, never leaf lamina absent
reason: FNA Carex: 'basal sheaths bladeless'; foliage blades described.

target: caudex absent (woody stem base); aerial stems PO:0009047 present, occasionally glaucous (PATO:0104277, not green)
fix: Do not treat 'caudex' as a synonym of PO:0009047 stem for absence statements: 'caudex absent' means the stems arise directly from the taproot. Remove or restrict the caudex synonym in config/po_lexicon.tsv
reason: PO lexicon lists caudex as a stem synonym, so the caudex absence became stem absence. The present quality is also wrong (glaucous, not green).

target: axillary leaf fascicles (secondary leaves on axillary short shoots) absent; main leaves present, bases forming a loose scarious sheath (leaf sheath PO:0020104 scarious)
fix: 'axillary leaves/fascicles absent' (Caryophyllaceae) = absence of leaves on axillary short shoots only, not of the leaf
reason: Qualifier 'axillary' dropped.

target: basal bladeless sheaths: scale leaf PO:0006003; foliage leaf lamina PO:0020039 present, scabrous
fix: Same as X03001
reason: Same Carex pattern as the doc's example.

target: cauline leaf PO:0000013 + absent PATO:0000462; basal leaves dentate
fix: Same as X03002
reason: Qualifier 'cauline' dropped.
